sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. Commencing Alpha Route; standing by until the second guard arrives.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street reporting a female street vagrant racially slandering staff members.

Arrived at the response location; spoke with the female vagrant and asked her to move along. She did not appear mentally stable, but we managed to escort her out without causing a scene or escalation.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store and Mid City, all clear. Standing by to show presence.
Patrolling down Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Wyndham Street intersection; area thoroughly cleared.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street intersection; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, no issues found.
Check-in at Commercial Bay; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, walkthrough completed within the area and checked in on all cafes within the location, all clear.
Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Continuing patrols; no activities requiring our assistance.
Welfare check at Metro Woolworths, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection; area thoroughly scoped for any issues, all clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring our presence is known.
Arrived at the corner of Albert and Wyndham Street; welfare checks commenced at Hollywood Bakery, Good To Go Supermarket and Barclay's Suites, all clear.
Welfare check commenced around The Cathedral Church and Federal Square, all clear.
Welfare check at The People's Barista, Little Albert's Coffee, Formery, Sergeant Coffee and Sky Mart, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Albert Street; area thoroughly checked for any issues, all clear.
Welfare check commenced at Crowne Plaza Hotel, making our way down through Atrium on Elliott, all clear.

Check-in at Aotea Square; heavy presence from members of the public, starting to get busier. Welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken Cafe, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Continuing patrols; no activities visible. Ending Alpha Route.
Welfare check at Nandos, Munster Inn, Queens Food Court and all stores within the area, all clear.
Check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; full sweep completed, all clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library, all clear.
Check-in at the corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, all clear. Commencing welfare checks on all stores within the lane.
Response call from Cotton On reporting a suspicious male individual inside the store holding a bottle of alcohol.
Arrived at the response location; the male had left prior to our arrival without causing any issues.
Response call from Peter Alexander reporting a suspicious male individual inside the store; immediate assistance requested.
Arrived at the response location; standing by for further notice from staff.
The male walked out without causing any issues — possibly the same individual from Cotton On. Standing by to show presence.
Continuing patrols and moving along to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check commenced along High Street stores, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall; area thoroughly checked for any vagrants causing issues, all clear.
Check-in at Chancery Square; full sweep completed within the vicinity, all clear. Standing by to ensure our presence is known while awaiting further response calls.
Check-in at Wilson Carpark; full scope of the area, welfare checks commenced with the static guards at the high-end stores and stores within the area, all clear.

Check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; welfare check inside Sienna Cafe, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo and all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting response calls.
Continuing patrols; ending Echo Route with no issues to report.
Commencing Delta Route. Check-in at the Kiwi Bank static guard and all stores nearby, all clear.
Welfare check completed at Adidas and McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay; full sweep completed within the location, all clear. Heading up into the Marina Mall for a quick restroom break.
Standing by to show presence before making our way to HQ.
Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence with quick welfare checks on all stores along the way.
Arrived at the bottom of HQ; welfare check at Starbucks and Lotus Foreign Exchange, all clear. Showing presence before heading upstairs for break.
Arrived at HQ; standing by to recharge the Ops Phone while awaiting response calls.
Response call from Michael Hill reporting a suspicious male individual inside the store making staff members feel uncomfortable; our presence requested on standby outside until further notice.
Arrived at the response location; standing by for staff to advise if they want him escorted out.
The individual has left the store without any further issues.
Arrived back at HQ; Ops Phone still on low battery, standing by to continue recharging and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key. Standing by until guards arrive.

Second guard has arrived; the standby guard has left. Guards were late due to heavy traffic — a rugby game at Eden Park and a concert at Spark Arena; expecting a busy shift. Gearing up before heading out on patrol.
Gearing up completed; commencing patrols down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street with welfare checks on all open businesses, all clear, no issues. Arrived at Britomart; commencing sweep (15:09–15:21).
Full sweep conducted at Britomart, all clear. Received a response call from Cotton On regarding a female vagrant outside the premises consuming illegal substances.
Arrived at the response location; kindly asked the vagrant to move along. Standing by until the vagrant and her belongings were off-site.
Welfare check at Cotton On, all clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrols up Queen Street.
Full sweep of upper Queen Street; welfare check, all clear:
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a sweep of the area (15:40–16:09).
Full sweep of Aotea Square complete; welfare checks on the public, JFC, Metrolanes Bowling and Event Cinemas, all clear, no issues. Patrolling through Metro Centre to Elliott.
Observed a damaged electric wire while patrolling through Metro Centre.
Metro Centre all clear; patrolling Elliott Street.
Sweep of Elliott Street; welfare check, all clear:
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare check at Mali Thai, Celine's Eatery and Recycle Boutique, all clear, no issues. Patrolling to HQ to retrieve items.
Items retrieved from the office; continuing patrols and welfare checks down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Durham Street and the corner of Durham; welfare checks at Midtown Mart, BBQ King and both Wilson Carparks. Continuing welfare checks on Queen Street.
Welfare checks from Mecca and Farmers through to OPSM and Hallensteins, all clear, no issues. Standing by in the middle of Queen Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street with welfare checks, all clear. Patrolling down Queen Street.

Full sweep conducted at Vulcan Lane. Received a response call from Cotton On regarding two male individuals who walked out of the premises with stolen goods; staff advised they headed down Queen Street. Patrolling the area to locate the POIs.
Located the POIs with the stolen products and retrieved them; heading back to Cotton On to return the products.
Arrived at Cotton On; products returned.
Standing down from Cotton On. Observed a vagrant drinking in public in front of Ippondo; approached and politely asked him not to drink in public. All clear, no issues; patrolling down Queen Street.
Received a response call from 77 Convenience Store regarding a group of vagrants consuming illegal substances outside the premises; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; the vagrants were no longer outside the site. Standing by for any issues that occur (17:30–17:57).
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear; heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Arrived at the office; commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed; commencing a 10-minute break.
Received a call from the AKA Rooftop Bar guard requesting to be let in.
Let the guard into the office, all clear; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Received a call from management to let them up to Level 7.
Let both management members into the office, all clear; commencing patrols up Queen Street.
Full sweep of upper Queen Street; welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, Avachi, Timezone Centre and 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Mid City to Elliott Stables.
Mid City all clear; arriving at Elliott Stables.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; commencing welfare checks and maintaining presence.
Continuing welfare checks and maintaining presence at Elliott Stables.
Received a false-alarm call from Cotton On; no issues confirmed.
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant inside the store disturbing customers; en route to the location.

Arrived at the location and observed the vagrant causing a disturbance; approached and asked him to leave politely. He was seen with alcohol and was notified that consuming alcohol inside the premises is strictly prohibited. Standing by until the vagrant left the area.
Received a call from management to make our way down to Kemuri to check whether the guard is on site; en route to the location.
Received a call from a member of the public regarding two male vagrants in front of Ippondo drinking in public; en route to the location.

Spoke with the vagrants and notified them that drinking alcohol in public places is strictly prohibited and that it must be put away. All clear, no issues; patrolling to HQ to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ; commencing a 30-minute break.
30-minute break completed; standing by until guard handover.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received (deployed 21:32): 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Radios.
Remained on standby at HQ awaiting the arrival of the security guard.
Security guard arrived on-site; remained on standby at HQ while charging the Ops Phone in preparation for patrols (21:38–22:07).

Received a report from Snickel Lane regarding a male vagrant outside their premises; the individual had already left after being advised that security services had been notified. No further response required.
Received a response call from Jo & Joe regarding an incident at their premises; responded to the location.

Arrived at Jo & Joe; Police were already on-site investigating the incident and gathering information. Security assisted by patrolling the surrounding area in an attempt to locate individuals matching the descriptions provided.
While patrolling the surrounding area, located an individual matching one of the descriptions associated with the incident; maintained observation and contacted Police to provide an update.
Police arrived at the location; security remained on standby to provide further assistance if required.
Stood down from the incident following Police attendance; Police departed the area and security remained with management.
Conducted a follow-up welfare check at Jo & Joe; remained in the surrounding area on standby for any further disturbances or response calls.
Welfare check along Fort Lane; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols towards High Street.
Received instructions from management to attend Auckland Harbour Suites; proceeded towards the location.
Management assistance completed; no issues reported. Continued patrols along Fort Street towards High Street.
Arrived at High Street and continued foot patrols through the area.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and commenced a full security sweep of the surrounding area (23:27–23:51).
Completed a full security sweep of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square; welfare checks on bars operating within the area. Continued patrols towards High Street.
Completed a full sweep of High Street; all clear, no issues reported. Returned towards HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ and commenced charging the Ops Phone before resuming patrols (23:58–01:00).
Welfare check at Darby Station, where a large event was taking place; all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Bar 101 and maintained a visible security presence while standing by for any incidents or disturbances (01:07–01:37).
Received instructions from management to remain on standby at Bar 101 until their arrival (01:37–02:16).
Management arrived at Bar 101; security remained on standby to provide assistance as required.
Management assistance concluded; welfare check at Bar 101, all clear. Departed towards HQ to provide access for the standby guard.
Arrived at HQ and provided access for the standby guard; no issues reported. Resumed patrols.
Conducted a full security sweep along Queen Street while heading towards Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart and commenced a full patrol sweep; maintained a visible security presence due to large crowds gathered within the area.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart; restaurant staff and the assigned security guard reported no concerns. All clear.
Completed a full security sweep of Britomart; continued patrols towards Lower Albert Street.
Welfare check with the security guard at Kemuri; all clear, no issues reported. Continued patrols along Lower Albert Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Lower Albert Street; all clear, no issues observed. Continued patrols towards Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Convenience Store; all clear, no concerns reported.
Completed a full patrol sweep of Albert Street; welfare check at SkyMart Convenience Store, all clear. Continued patrols towards Victoria Street.
Completed patrol of Victoria Street; all clear, no issues reported. Continued towards Bar 101.
Welfare check at Elliott Carpark; all clear, no issues observed.
Arrived at Bar 101 and maintained security presence while monitoring the venue and surrounding area until closing (03:32–04:00).
Welfare check at Bar 101; continued maintaining security presence while waiting for crowds in the surrounding area to disperse.
Stood down from Bar 101; the area was clear with no issues reported. Continued patrols along Victoria Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Victoria Street; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Continued patrols towards Federal Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Federal Street; all clear, no issues observed. Arrived at Federal Square and commenced a patrol sweep of the area.
Completed a full security sweep of Federal Square; all clear, no issues identified. Welfare checks at St Patrick's Cathedral and Liston House, both clear with no concerns reported.
Completed patrol of the lower section of Federal Street; all clear, no issues observed. Continued patrols towards Fanshawe Street.
Completed patrol of Fanshawe Street; all clear, no issues reported. Proceeded towards Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart and commenced a full security sweep of the area (04:57–05:25).
Completed a full security sweep of Britomart and conducted a welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. Continued patrols towards Queen Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Queen Street; all clear, no issues reported. Arrived at HQ and commenced a 30-minute break while remaining available for response calls.
Meal break completed; remained on standby at HQ awaiting the incoming security guard for shift handover.
Night shift concluded; handover completed with the incoming shift.

flags: SENSITIVE: 06:53 racial abuse directed at McDonald's Queen Street staff by a female street vagrant; escorted out without escalation.
CAPACITY: 20:25 management request to check on the Kemuri guard was overtaken by the 20:27 Ippondo public call — no completion of the Kemuri check is recorded in the log before the 20:33 break.

QA: staffing/time anomalies — morning ran single-guard until the second guard arrived 07:00; afternoon guards arrived late at 14:45/14:51 (heavy traffic, Eden Park rugby + Spark Arena concert); afternoon shift concluded 21:30 (an hour early per log) with night shift deployed 21:32.
QA: raw timestamp '1659' between 19:56 and 20:01 entries re-sequenced as 19:59 (obvious typo).
QA: 16:12 damaged electric wire observed in Metro Centre — hazard noted in log, no follow-up recorded.

capacity.call: Management request — welfare check on Kemuri guard
capacity.note: Overtaken by the 20:27 Ippondo response call; no completion recorded.
